title: Arriving in Paradise
summary: DI Poole arrives in Saint Marie to investigate the murder of his predecessor, DI Charlie Hulme. Hulme was found shot dead in a panic room
method: The victim was initially shot by someone else, hid in the panic room, and was shot again by the person who opened the panic room. The person who fired the initial shot is the second victim.
motive: DI Hulme had proof of the human trafficking that the killer was involved in, and was clutching a book with names involved. The book was later swapped out by the killer. The killer was fed up with being passed up for promotions and thought it would be a better option to be a crooked cop and make money on the side.
notes: The actor playing Dwayne is still finding the voice for his character so Dwayne (and even Fidel) have British accents here. You can also tell that Sgt Lily won't be a returning character because they don't develop the character at all.
